newsitem.title: USA: Reuters buys remaining stake in AdValue.
newsitem.headline: Reuters buys remaining stake in AdValue.

text.p: Reuters NewMedia Inc said on Monday it had acquired the remaining stake in AdValue Media Technologies Inc for $12 million from Westinghouse Electric Corp.
Reuters NewMedia said it now owns all of the issued capital of AdValue.
Reuters NewMedia is a U.S. subsidiary of Reuters Holdings Plc.

Reuters NewMedia said the deal includes an eight-year agreement between AdValue and Westinghouse to make AdValue the exclusive provider of eletronic advertising transaction services to 14 television stations owned by Westinghouse's CBS network.
AdValue provides advertisement-tracking services to the industry, as well as supporting the buying and selling of spot television advertising time through its electronic network.

"In taking full ownership of AdValue, Reuters completes the first stage of a new infrastructure from which it can extend its presence as a provider of news, market information, transaction services, research and analysis to the advertising, marketing and media industries," Reuters NewMedia President Buford Smith said.
Reuters NewMedia previously owned 50 percent of AdValue.
